title: Payoff and Loan Satisfaction Clause on Satisfaction and Lien Release
content:
# Satisfaction of a payoff case and release of the lien

Payoff and Loan Satisfaction — satisfaction clause.

(a) A funds-based case is satisfied on the day the net amount remitted on the case (every receipt less every returned receipt) first reaches the required payoff amount, and a Deed in Lieu of Foreclosure case on the day the deed recording is confirmed by a deed-in-lieu recording submission.

(b) A case whose plan needs a signed agreement is satisfied only from accepted status; the Borrower Voluntary Payoff and the HECM-to-HECM Refinance Payoff are satisfied from terms issued.

(c) Funds count toward satisfaction only when they are received no later than the plan's late-funds tolerance of calendar days after the statement's good-through date. The clock starts from the good-through date recorded on the payoff case. Those days are counted as calendar days starting the day after the good-through date, and funds received on the last counted day still count.

(d) Funds received after the good-through date but within the tolerance must also cover the per diem for each day past the good-through date, which is added to the required payoff amount, as the plan's interest-through basis provides.

(e) For the HECM-to-HECM Refinance Payoff the funds are accepted only after the new loan's rescission period has ended, as the plan's rescission setting provides.

(f) On satisfaction the required payoff amount is applied to the loan, the loan is marked paid in full or, where the plan proceeds to an insurance claim, claim-terminated, any open maturity case is resolved, and the lien release is sent for recording within the plan's lien-release period of calendar days. The required amount is applied once per case.

### Boundary cases under (c) and (d)

With the 5-day tolerance shown in the plan schedule and a hypothetical per diem of USD 20.00:

| Day the funds are received | Counts toward satisfaction | Per diem added to the required amount |
|---|---|---|
| On the good-through date | yes | none |
| 3rd day after the good-through date | yes | 3 days, USD 60.00 |
| 5th day after the good-through date | yes (last counted day) | 5 days, USD 100.00 |
| 6th day after the good-through date | no | — |

The per diem in the table is invented for the illustration.
